claim: Community patterns show SKEL files are sectioned (bone, model, animation, indices, cloth, footer) with bones identified by 32-bit name hashes; 364 bone-name hashes are published.
evidence: skel.hexpat defines section IDs 0xDCDCFF00..05 and 0xDCDCFF99; enums.hexpat lists 364 bone names.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN - source does not state a game build; not checked against 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001
verification_method: Read the pattern files. Verify on our build by parsing an extracted .skel and checking section IDs and hash collisions.
limitations: Animation section internals (curves, compression) are not mapped; the hash function is not documented.
next_experiment: Identify the bone-name hash algorithm (test common hashes against the published name/value pairs) for use in a future animation-state sync.
